items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I went out with Tommy-- ... Yes. Bill had just been drafted and Tommy idolized Bill. I don't know how I came to go, but they needed-- they had Hugo Winterhalter and me... That lasted about three weeks

ctx.x: He paid me for a year and then I went back to work again.
I think it came to about '44, that's the period when I couldn't hear anymore and I had to stop.
